search.query: index=botsv1 sourcetype=fortigate_utm attack=* | top limit=10 attack
index=botsv1 sourcetype=suricata | spath | search event_type=alert | eval vendor_severity=coalesce(severity, 'alert.severity', "unknown") | stats count by vendor_severity
